page.layout: One printed page: the front board of a bound volume, a worn tan leather cover with a grey cloth spine on the right. No printed text block. Faint mirrored ink traces run diagonally across the upper part of the board, and a small handwritten or stamped mark sits at the lower right.
page.notes: Cover board only, not a printed page. The diagonal marks in the upper centre are show-through or staining from the leather surface, not printed words, and cannot be read. The small marks at the lower right and bottom centre are handwriting or label residue and are not transcribed. Spine is blank grey cloth. No text is printed on this page.
